specs.title: sidebar: Write On entry registered alongside core panels
doc lifecycle: new document, typing, stats, autosave
word variant: markers, alternatives panel, original immutable
AI alternatives (test provider): 3 options, select switches text + a/an link
manual alternative + cycling rotates options in place
sentence + paragraph variants; word variant nests inside sentence variant
partial-cross selection prompts expand-or-cancel
ghost: manual dim mark; revive restores opacity
overflow: stash cuts text atomically; insert restores copy; edit & delete
lab: six goals wired; hedges-filler marks "really"
fix-punctuation: only goal that applies text changes
trim: 20% review → keep/cut/skip → make-the-cuts → original restore → done
undo/redo restores text atomically
persistence: reload keeps document and entities
export downloads JSON; import re-creates document
share: preview overlay, copy, X confirm, LinkedIn egg
hide controls: toolbar chrome collapses
shortcuts scoped to writing focus: Alt+Enter variant, Ctrl+/ ghost
chinese: typing, stats, word/sentence variants, ghost, persistence
ui language: 中/EN switcher localizes the whole panel and persists
